svg.text: How your Pi gets new apps
Three ways in. Each one ends with the app open on your Pi, walled off from everything else.
Every app can carry Joshua's seal, a signature only his key can make. The Pi reads it first.
only the person in charge (an admin) can run it.
never. Someone changed it after it was sealed.
Next: the Pi builds its own apps, with no Mac in the middle.
Drawn by tools/gen/humans.py. The full map is architecture.svg.
